job.job_description:
Are you ready to redefine what's possible with artificial intelligence? At Techolution, a leader in 'innovation done right,' we're seeking a visionary Associate AI Engineer to join our pioneering team. This is an unparalleled
opportunity to harness your expertise in Python, Generative AI, LLM Agents, and advanced Prompt Engineering, crafting sophisticated solutions that bridge the gap from lab-grade concepts to real-world impact. If you're driven to orchestrate intelligent systems and contribute to transformative projects for enterprise clients, step into a role where your innovation truly matters.


Designation: Associate AI Engineer
Location: Hyderabad, India
Employment Type: Full Time
Expertise: Associate


Key Responsibilities:



Develop and implement robust AI models and generative solutions, ensuring high performance and scalability for real-world applications.
Design, optimize, and orchestrate advanced large language model frameworks, leveraging sophisticated techniques to enhance AI system capabilities and user interaction.
Transform complex data and research into practical generative AI applications, continuously exploring and integrating cutting-edge advancements.
Manage and maintain AI codebase, taking full responsibility for version control, code integrity, and collaborative development workflows.
Contribute to the entire AI development lifecycle with dedication and passion, from conceptualization and prototyping to deployment and optimization, ensuring solutions meet stringent quality standards.
Actively analyze project requirements, translating them into actionable technical specifications, driving the successful delivery of innovative AI solutions.

Foundational Skills:


Proven expertise in Python Programming, demonstrating the ability to write clean, efficient, and scalable code essential for developing complex AI models and applications.
Deep understanding and practical experience with LLM - Agents, Tools, Orchestrator, enabling the design and implementation of sophisticated AI systems that can perform complex tasks autonomously.
Solid foundation in Gen AI principles and applications, crucial for innovating and building next-generation generative models that push the boundaries of AI capabilities.
Mastery of effective Prompting techniques, vital for extracting precise and relevant outputs from large language models and optimizing AI system performance.
Proficiency in Git for version control, ensuring seamless collaboration, robust code management, and efficient tracking of development progress.
Demonstrated Ownership over projects and tasks, taking full responsibility for outcomes and proactively driving initiatives to completion.
Possession of a strong Seeker Mindset, characterized by an insatiable curiosity and a proactive approach to learning new technologies and solving challenging problems.
Exhibiting a genuine Passionate Towards Work, translating into high-quality contributions and a relentless pursuit of excellence in every aspect of AI development.
Displaying an Extremely Ambitious drive to achieve significant impact and contribute to groundbreaking advancements in the field of artificial intelligence.
Upholding an Unbeatable Work Ethics, consistently delivering high-quality results with dedication, reliability, and a commitment to meeting deadlines.
Exceptional Ability to comprehend complex technical concepts and business requirements, enabling effective problem-solving and the development of highly relevant AI solutions.



Advanced Skills



Experience with Docker for containerization and deployment, streamlining the packaging and distribution of AI applications across various environments.
Familiarity with GCP (Google Cloud Platform) services, particularly those relevant to AI/ML, which can accelerate model deployment and scalable infrastructure management.
